criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only strict=False to Marker.evaluate. Default environment overlay behavior remains byte-compatible. Opt-in strict=True starts from no host variables and uses only caller mapping plus existing context defaults (metadata extra="", lock_file empty extras/dependency_groups). Missing referenced variables raise UndefinedEnvironmentName, including RHS variables. Repair supplied python_full_version dev suffix only if present, normalize supplied extra and never mutate caller mappings. Do not query host default_environment in strict mode or invent values for unrelated variables.
